Sem memória, sem avaliação, sem contexto: No memory, no evaluation, no persistent context. Every interaction starts from zero. E.g., an FAQ chatbot that returns the most likely answer and never improves.
Lembra quem você é e personaliza. Mas se: It remembers who you are and personalizes. But if it makes the same mistake ten times, nobody fixes the environment. E.g., an assistant that knows your name, job title, and calendar.
Raciocina, escolhe ferramentas e age. Se: It reasons, picks tools, and acts. Without evaluation, it repeats mistakes indefinitely: it's sophisticated automation. E.g., it schedules meetings and books the wrong time five times in a row.
ação → avaliação → feedback → ajuste → n: action → evaluation → feedback → adjustment → new run
Tudo do agente, mais o ciclo completo: c: Everything the agent does, plus the full cycle: every run is evaluated, mistakes become rules, and autonomy grows as consistency grows. The weights don't change; the garden does.
1→2 adiciona memória e contexto. 2→3 adi: 1→2 adds memory and context. 2→3 adds tools and autonomy. 3→4 adds evaluation, feedback, and adjustment of the environment.
A maioria das implementações para no deg: Most implementations stop at step 2 or 3 and call it "advanced AI." Cultivation begins when the cycle closes.
Memória é personalização e contexto pers: Memory is personalization and persistent context: "I know you prefer morning meetings." The next conversation starts from a richer base.
Mas a forma como o sistema decide, age e: But the way the system decides, acts, and fails stays the same.
Cultivo é mudança de comportamento com e: Cultivation is a change in behavior backed by evidence: it runs, fails, logs, analyzes, changes the rule, runs again, and compares.
Semana passada: 14/20 acertos. Esta sema: Last week: 14/20 correct. This week: 18/20. Version 1.0 had 5 rules; 1.3 has 12, all coming from real mistakes.
O sistema lembra que você não gosta de r: The system remembers you don't like long meetings and starts suggesting 30 minutes. If three 30-minute meetings fail because the topic didn't fit, it will keep suggesting 30.
Cultivo diria: \"se a pauta tem mais de: Cultivation would say: "if the agenda has more than 3 items, suggest 45 minutes."
Memória responde: \"o que você sabe sobr: Memory answers: "what do you know about me?"
Cultivo responde: \"o que você faz difer: Cultivation answers: "what do you do differently today compared to last month, and why?" If the system can only answer the first, it has memory.
It works, it solves the problem, but it doesn't evolve.
Resposta errada, você reformula e tenta: Wrong answer, you rephrase and try again. You learned to ask better; the system stays the same.
Consultar documentos antes de responder: Looking up documents before answering improves accuracy, but if the wrong document was retrieved, nobody logs it. The system doesn't correct itself.
Fixed steps that always run the same way. If the email format changes, it breaks. An LLM node in the middle doesn't turn automation into an agent.
Raciocina, usa ferramentas, entrega. Nin: Reasons, uses tools, delivers. Nobody measures whether the result is good. It repeats the same mistakes with the same confidence.
